items.q: Will the Word document look exactly like the PDF?
items.a: Text and basic layout convert well for most documents, but complex designs, scanned pages, or unusual fonts may not convert perfectly — this is a known limitation of automated PDF-to-Word conversion in general, not unique to this tool.

items.q: Is converting PDF to Word free?
items.a: Yes, converting PDF to Word is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
